# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

### Рад приветствовать Вас на этом сайте!

Меня зовут Бетехтин Михаил Сергеевич, я кандидат медицинских наук, дерматовенеролог, онколог и
врач-косметолог. С 14 лет моя жизнь неразрывно связана с медициной. Все годы обучения в училище,
затем в университете и после получения диплома лишь утвердили меня в правильности выбранного
направления. На сайте Вы можете найти информационные материалы, касающиеся различных вопросов
дерматологии, венерологии, косметологии и дерматоонкологии.

### Мои знания и навыки к Вашим услугам

Знакомство с устройством западного образования дерматовенеролога и с системой оказания помощи
больным кожными и венерическими болезнями заставило меня изучить все необходимые разделы
дерматовенерологии (дерматология, венерология, косметология, опухоли кожи), чтобы овладеть знаниями
и навыками на международном уровне. В своей работе я руководствуюсь принципами доказательной
медицины и постоянно совершенствую свои знания. Мои контактные данные и место работы Вы можете найти

# EUROPEAN BRAIN COUNCIL

### The European Brain Council (EBC) is a network of key players in the “Brain Area”,
### with a membership encompassing scientific societies,
### patient organisations, professional societies and industry partners.

### WHO WE ARE

A non-profit organisation based in Brussels, its main mission is to promote brain research with the
ultimate goal of improving the lives of the millions of Europeans living with brain conditions.

[MISSION][129]

### WHAT WE DO

With the aim to speak with one voice, EBC stands as the platform to foster cooperation between its
member organisations and other stakeholders, consistently promoting dialogue between scientists,
industry and society.

[MEMBERS][130]

### PROJECTS & INITIATIVES

EBC has been involved in many projects ever since its creation and continues to be, both EU-funded
and EBC/Partner funded. Its participation in these projects results from concerted discussions with
its members organisations.

# NF affects 1 in every 2,000 births

**What is NF?** NF refers to a group of genetic conditions that cause tumors to grow on nerves
throughout the body. NF includes neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) and all types of schwannomatosis
(SWN), including *NF2*-related schwannomatosis (*NF2*-SWN), formerly known as neurofibromatosis type
2, or *NF2*. NF affects 4 million people worldwide. Anyone can be born with NF, and it impacts
everyone differently.

## We are the Drug Discovery Engine for NF

### Everything the Children's Tumor Foundation (CTF) does is to bring treatments to patients as we
### work toward a cure.

[Read About CTF's Impact][89]

# For Families

to hope through the Children’s Tumor Foundation (CTF). Kimberly Snipes shares how CTF became a
lifeline, offering answers, support, and a community that understands. Watch her story, and discover
how CTF can be a source of strength and guidance for you, too.

# NF affects 1 in every 2,000 births

**What is NF?** NF refers to a group of genetic conditions that cause tumors to grow on nerves
throughout the body. NF includes neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) and all types of schwannomatosis
(SWN), including *NF2*-related schwannomatosis (*NF2*-SWN), formerly known as neurofibromatosis type
2, or *NF2*. NF affects 4 million people worldwide. Anyone can be born with NF, and it impacts
everyone differently.

# Bold ideas. Big Impact.

Van Andel Institute began with a vision: improve human health through biomedical research and
science education. We do more than dream about it, we strive to make it a reality every day.

[Learn More][45]

## ABOUT VAI

Van Andel Institute engages the world’s brightest minds and advances the boldest ideas in pursuit of
the biggest breakthroughs for humanity.

## RESEARCH, EDUCATE, INSPIRE

Every day, we collaborate at the forefront of fundamental and translational science in pursuit of
breakthrough treatment strategies for cancer, Parkinson’s and other diseases.

We believe that hope for tomorrow lives in the students of today. Our Graduate School offers a
rigorous research-intensive Ph.D. program that develops leaders in molecular and cellular biology.
Our inquiry-based approaches for K–12 education help create classrooms where curiosity, creativity
and critical thinking thrive.

### Research

How do you arrive at revolutionary treatments and breakthroughs? By unleashing a global coalition of
brilliant scientific minds, fostering an entrepreneurial, collaborative process — and doing a world
of good.

[ Learn More ][52]

### Graduate School

Van Andel Institute Graduate School develops scientists to be tomorrow’s biomedical research leaders
through an intense, problem-focused Ph.D. degree in molecular and cell biology.

[ Learn More ][53]

### K-12 Education

We create classrooms where curiosity, creativity and critical thinking thrive.

[ Learn More ][54]

### Our People


How do we move closer each day to improving health and enhancing lives? By bringing together
hard-working scientists, educators, staff and students and providing the resources and support
necessary for them to succeed.

[ Learn More ][55]

### Donor Stories


Each of our dedicated supporters has a story for why they give: a mother diagnosed with breast
cancer, a brother living with Parkinson’s, a lifelong passion for educating children, or something
else entirely. We are honored to share them all.

#### About the Journal

The CosmoDerma (CSDM) is an open-access peer-reviewed journal launched in 2021 committed to
publishing high-quality articles in the field of Cosmetic Dermatology, both clinical and aesthetic
dermatology, provide clinical insights and potential treatment options, to foster the highest
standards of patient care in Cosmetic Dermatology. The CSDM provides dermatologists with up-to-date,
evidence-based information that can be applied to their daily practices. The journal is owned and
published by the [Scientific Scholar][72], facilitating continuing professional development and
providing a forum for exchanging scientific research and innovative techniques.

publishing high-quality articles in the field of Cosmetic Dermatology, both clinical and aesthetic

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

### What is GOMEKLI?

GOMEKLI (mirdametinib) is a prescription medicine used to treat adults and children 2 years of age
and older with neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) who have plexiform neurofibromas (PN) that cause
symptoms and cannot be completely removed by surgery.

It is not known if GOMEKLI is safe and effective in children under 2 years of age.

### Important Safety Information

#### Before taking GOMEKLI, tell your healthcare provider about all of your medical conditions,
#### including if you:
* Have eye problems
* Have heart problems
* Are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. GOMEKLI can harm your unborn baby
  
  #### Females who are able to become pregnant:
  * Your healthcare provider should check to see if you are pregnant before you begin treatment with
    GOMEKLI.
  * Use effective birth control (contraception) during treatment with GOMEKLI and for 6 weeks after
    your last dose.
  * Tell your healthcare provider right away if you become pregnant or think you may be pregnant
    during treatment with GOMEKLI.
  
  #### Males with female partners who are able to become pregnant:
  * Use effective birth control (contraception) during treatment with GOMEKLI and for 3 months after
    your last dose.
  * Tell your healthcare provider right away if your female partner becomes pregnant or thinks she
    may be pregnant during treatment with GOMEKLI.
* Are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed. It is not known if GOMEKLI passes into your breastmilk.
  * Do not breastfeed during treatment with GOMEKLI and for 1 week after your last dose.
  * Talk to your healthcare provider about the best way to feed your baby during this time.

**Tell your healthcare provider about all the medicines you take,** including prescription and
over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements.

### How should I take GOMEKLI?
* Take GOMEKLI exactly as your healthcare provider tells you to take it. Your healthcare provider
  may change your dose, temporarily stop, or permanently stop treatment with GOMEKLI if you develop
  certain side effects.
* Take GOMEKLI twice a day, about 12 hours apart, for 21 days, followed by 7 days off treatment, to
  complete a 28-day treatment cycle. Your healthcare provider will decide how many treatment cycles
  are right for you.
* Take GOMEKLI with or without food.
* GOMEKLI comes in two different dosage forms, GOMEKLI capsules and GOMEKLI tablets for oral

  * Do not breastfeed during treatment with GOMEKLI and for 1 week after your last dose.
  * Talk to your healthcare provider about the best way to feed your baby during this time.

**Tell your healthcare provider about all the medicines you take,** including prescription and
over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements.

### How should I take GOMEKLI?

  may change your dose, temporarily stop, or permanently stop treatment with GOMEKLI if you develop
  certain side effects.
* Take GOMEKLI twice a day, about 12 hours apart, for 21 days, followed by 7 days off treatment, to
  complete a 28-day treatment cycle. Your healthcare provider will decide how many treatment cycles
  are right for you.
* Take GOMEKLI with or without food.
* GOMEKLI comes in two different dosage forms, GOMEKLI capsules and GOMEKLI tablets for oral
  suspension. Your healthcare provider will decide the dosage form and dose of GOMEKLI that is right
  for you.
* **If you take GOMEKLI capsules**: Swallow each capsule whole with drinking water. If more than 1
  capsule is required, swallow 1 capsule at a time. Do not open, break or chew the capsules.
* **If you take GOMEKLI tablets for oral suspension, either**:
  * Swallow each tablet for oral suspension whole with drinking water. If more than 1 tablet is
    required, swallow 1 tablet at a time.
  * #### OR
  * Disperse the tablets for oral suspension in drinking water to make a liquid (suspension) before
    you take or give GOMEKLI.
  
  See the “Instructions for Use” that come with your medicine for instructions on how to prepare and
  take GOMEKLI tablets for oral suspension.
* If you miss a dose of GOMEKLI, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at your regularly
  scheduled time.
* If you vomit at any time after taking GOMEKLI, do not take an additional dose. Take your next dose
  at your regularly scheduled time.

### What are the possible side effects of GOMEKLI?

**GOMEKLI may cause serious side effects, including:**
* **Eye problems.** GOMEKLI may cause eye problems that can lead to blindness. Your healthcare
  provider will check your vision before and during treatment with GOMEKLI. Tell your healthcare
  provider right away if you get any of the following signs or symptoms of eye problems:
  * Blurred vision
  * Loss of vision
  * Other changes to your vision

# [Our Services]Healthcare Integration Services for Labs and Hospitals

[ Let's talk about your project ][61]

We help healthcare organizations connect EHR, LIS, PACS, and billing workflows using HL7, FHIR, and
secure APIs. Whether you need new interfaces, modernization, or ongoing support, our team focuses on
reliable data exchange you can maintain.

### What we integrate

Healthcare integrations usually break when standards, vendors, and workflows don’t line up. We help
teams connect the systems and formats they rely on most:
* **[HL7 v2 messaging][62]**: ADT, ORM, ORU, and custom interface workflows
* **[FHIR APIs and SMART on FHIR][63]** use cases
* **[EHR integrations][64]** for clinical and operational data exchange
* **[LIS integrations][65]** for lab orders, results, and outreach connectivity
* **[PACS and imaging workflows (DICOM)][66]** that need reliable routing and access
* **[RCM integrations][67]** for eligibility, claims, remittance, and reporting
* **[Healthcare API development][68]** for secure system-to-system connectivity

Not sure where to start? **[A short discovery call][69]** usually clarifies the best path.

## KOSELUGO^{®} (selumetinib) is approved for adults living with NF1 plexiform neurofibromas

Koselugo is an FDA-approved therapy for adults and children 1 year of age and older with
neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) who have plexiform neurofibromas (PN) that cause symptoms and cannot
be completely removed by surgery.

Koselugo in Adults Koselugo in Children
[Sarah, age 42, living with NF1 PN. Sarah is not currently taking Koselugo.]

Sarah, age 42, living with NF1 PN.

## You’ve been fighting a fearsome opponent. Now shrink it down to size.

In a clinical study, 66% (33/50) of children and teens with NF1 saw their plexiform neurofibroma
shrink by at least 20% with Koselugo. In a separate clinical study, after 16 months of treatment,
20% of adults treated with Koselugo (14/71) saw their plexiform neurofibroma shrink by at least 20%
from the start of the study compared with 5% (4/74) of adults on placebo.^{*}

See more study details in the links below.

Koselugo in Adults Koselugo in Children

*A placebo is a treatment that doesn't contain medicine.

[Kylie, age 19, living with NF1 PN. Kylie is currently taking Koselugo.]

Kylie, age 19, living with NF1 PN.

## Koselugo is backed by almost 8 years of established safety in children and teens

In the SPRINT Phase 1 and Phase 2 Stratum 1 studies, 74 children and teens received Koselugo twice
daily. Half received Koselugo for more than 4.4 years. Treatment duration ranged from 28 days to 7.7
years.

See more study details in the link below.

**What are the possible side effects of Koselugo?****
**Koselugo may cause serious side effects, including:****
* Heart problems. Koselugo can lower the amount of blood pumped by your heart, which can be severe.
  Your healthcare provider will do tests before and during treatment to check how well your heart is
  working. Tell your healthcare provider right away if you get any of the following signs or
  symptoms: persistent coughing or wheezing, shortness of breath, swelling of your ankles and feet,
  tiredness, increased heart rate.
* Eye problems. Koselugo can cause eye problems that can lead to blindness. Your healthcare provider
  will check your vision before and during treatment. Tell your healthcare provider right away if
  you get new or worsening vision changes, including: blurred vision, loss of vision, dark spots in
  your vision (floaters), other changes to your vision.
* Stomach, intestine, and mouth (gastrointestinal) problems. Koselugo can cause diarrhea, vomiting,
  nausea, and mouth sores. Diarrhea can be severe with Koselugo. Tell your healthcare provider right
  away the first time that you get diarrhea during treatment. Your healthcare provider may give you
  medicine to help control your diarrhea and may tell you to drink more fluids.
* Skin problems. Koselugo can cause severe skin rashes. Tell your healthcare provider if you get any
  of the following signs of skin problems: rash that covers a large area of your body, flat skin
  rash, raised bumps on your skin, skin bumps that look like acne, blisters, peeling skin, itchy
  rash, hair thinning or hair loss (alopecia).

NF Midwest is committed to improving the lives of children, adults, and families impacted by

# Welcome to OnPatient

The easy way to manage your personal health records

[Sign Up][4] [COVID-19 Updates][5]

## Take control of your medical records.

Securely connect with all your medical providers with OnPatient, trusted by over 13 million users.
Gain access to your information via web or the OnPatient App.

[[Onpatient patient portal on ipad, iphone, or web]][6]

## How to Connect

[envelope show to send email invite to patients to access Onpatient icon]

#### STEP 1

Ask your provider to send you an email invite to the OnPatient Portal.

[Check list on how to sign up icon]

#### STEP 2

Open the OnPatient invite email, press the “sign up” button and register online.

[ipad and iphone downloading app icon]

#### STEP 3

[Download][7] the OnPatient app from the Apple App Store.

[continual user icon]

#### STEP 4

Launch the OnPatient app and log in to connect to your medical provider.

## Through the OnPatient portal, you can
* Fill out any paperwork before your appointment to make checking in easier
* View your upcoming appointments and check-in online
* Schedule and cancel appointments from your computer or mobile device
* Message your doctor through a HIPAA compliant portal
* Manage your contact and insurance information
* Access your medical record
* Have educational material sent directly to your account
* Connect your child's account and manage their health record with yours
* View statements and pay online

* Each practice personalizes OnPatient, some of these features may not be available.

## Built by the community.

A growing ecosystem of open source plugins extends OIE into the work you actually need to do. Here
are a few.

[See all plugins →][22]
* [ [TLS Manager screenshot] ][23]
  
  ### TLS Manager
  
  Browser-based and in-Administrator certificate management for OIE. Inspect the Java trust store,
  add trusted certificates, and manage local key pairs, with search, validity dates, and
  fingerprints.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][24]
* [ [Cache Manager screenshot] ][25]
  
  ### Cache Manager
  
  In-memory key-value lookups against external databases, with lazy loading, HikariCP pooling, and a
  dedicated admin UI and inspector.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][26]
* [ [Channel & Code Template History screenshot] ][27]
  
  ### Channel & Code Template History
  
  Built-in version history for channels and code templates. Side-by-side diff viewer with word-level
  highlighting, right-click revert, and database-backed storage.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][28]
* [ [Source Code Search screenshot] ][29]
  
  ### Source Code Search
  
  Grep across channel scripts, code templates, global scripts, and message templates, with regex,
  scoping, highlighted matches, and JSON/CSV export.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][30]

## Clinical Trial Matching You Can Understand

Unlike black-box AI systems, Panda Trial shows exactly why each trial made your list.

### Clinical Profile Alignment

Your health profile is matched against specific study criteria to ensure clinical eligibility before
you apply to any trial.

### Patient-Centric Logistics

Find clinical trials near you with proximity analysis that factors in travel distance to ensure
participation is practical.

### Deterministic Evaluations

match score.

[Learn How Clinical Trial Matching Works][11]

## What is Panda Trial?

Panda Trial (also written PandaTrial) is an AI-powered clinical trial matching platform that helps
patients find clinical trials they are actually eligible for. Unlike generic keyword searches on
ClinicalTrials.gov, Panda Trial analyzes your complete health profile — condition, age, medications,
location — against each trial's specific eligibility criteria to deliver ranked, transparent
matches.

Panda Trial — also written PandaTrial, and often searched as Panda Trial AI — is free for patients.
We sync new and updated studies from ClinicalTrials.gov every day, validate every condition against
real clinical vocabularies like MeSH and SNOMED CT, and check your profile against each study's
eligibility criteria — so a match on Panda Trial is a study you can genuinely pursue.

Every match includes a visible score breakdown across three pillars — clinical eligibility,
geographic distance, and trial quality — so you can verify why each trial made your list. No hidden
algorithms, no promoted placements, no black boxes.

## How AI Clinical Trial Matching Works

Panda Trial's 6-layer pipeline combines clinical vocabularies, deterministic rules, and focused AI
to find trials you qualify for.

## Built by a Clinical Research Professional

Panda Trial was created by a certified clinical research coordinator with experience managing
pediatric studies at Children's Hospital Los Angeles and multi-site diabetes device trials at
Medtronic. With a Master's degree in Clinical and Translational Research from George Washington
University, the founder built Panda Trial to solve a problem seen firsthand: qualified patients who
could benefit from a clinical trial had no reliable way to find one.

[Read our approach to clinical trial matching][13]

## Clinical Trial Matching FAQ

Common questions about finding clinical trials with Panda Trial.

### How does Panda Trial find clinical trials for my condition?

Panda Trial uses a multi-layer system that starts by validating your condition against clinical
databases to find truly relevant trials. Then it checks your eligibility, scores each trial on a
weighted formula, and uses AI to detect medication conflicts and parse complex criteria. The result
is a ranked list of clinical trials you are actually eligible for — not just keyword matches.

### Is Panda Trial better than searching ClinicalTrials.gov directly?

ClinicalTrials.gov is the authoritative database, and Panda Trial searches the same trials. The
difference is how results are filtered and presented. ClinicalTrials.gov uses keyword matching,
which returns trials that mention your condition anywhere — including irrelevant contexts. Panda
Trial validates relevance through clinical databases, checks your specific eligibility criteria, and
ranks results by how well they match your complete profile.

### Can I use Panda Trial without creating an account?

Yes. Guest matching lets you enter your condition, age, gender, and zip code to find clinical trials
immediately — no signup required. Creating a free account unlocks additional features like saved
matches, application tracking, medication conflict analysis, and more detailed AI reasoning for your
top matches.

patients find clinical trials they are actually eligible for. Unlike generic keyword searches on
ClinicalTrials.gov, Panda Trial analyzes your complete health profile — condition, age, medications,
location — against each trial's specific eligibility criteria to deliver ranked, transparent
matches.

Panda Trial — also written PandaTrial, and often searched as Panda Trial AI — is free for patients.

real clinical vocabularies like MeSH and SNOMED CT, and check your profile against each study's
eligibility criteria — so a match on Panda Trial is a study you can genuinely pursue.

Every match includes a visible score breakdown across three pillars — clinical eligibility,
geographic distance, and trial quality — so you can verify why each trial made your list. No hidden
algorithms, no promoted placements, no black boxes.

# Pasithea is a biotechnology company focused on the discovery, research and development of
# innovative treatments for central nervous system (CNS) disorders and RASopathies.

Pasithea is developing new therapeutics for the treatment of neurological disorders, including solid
tumors, Neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1), Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), and schizophrenia.

## Our Focus

Our research on therapies is currently focused on developing treatment options for:

## Neurofibromatosis Type 1 (NF1)

NF1 is part of a group of conditions known as neurocutaneous disorders that affect the skin and the
nervous system. NF1 causes tumor growth along nerves in the skin, brain, near the spinal cord and
other parts of the body. These tumors are usually benign (non-cancerous), however they cause a range
of symptoms with varying severity among affected people. People with NF1 typically have problems
with their bones, eyes and nervous system, as well as other complications, including high blood
pressure, learning disabilities, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), seizures and
speech problems. Further, some people with NF1 develop cancerous tumors that grow along nerves and
are at a higher risk of developing other forms of cancer. NF1 accounts for approximately 90% of all
neurofibromatosis cases and occurs in about 1 in 3,000 births. There is no known cure for NF1 and
treatment options vary.

## Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)

ALS is a progressive neurodegenerative disease that affects nerve cells in the brain and spinal
cord, causing loss of muscle control. It most commonly affects people between the ages of 40 and 70,
with an average age of 55 at the time of diagnosis. The average life expectancy after diagnosis is
two to five years, but some patients may live for years or even decades. Currently there is no known
cure or treatment that halts or reverses the progression of ALS, and FDA only approved 2 medications
so far for the treatment of this disorder, both shown to modestly slow the progression of ALS.

## Multiple Sclerosis (MS)

Multiple sclerosis is a chronic and potentially disabling autoimmune disease, and the most common
neurodegenerative disease of the central nervous system in young adults. The pathological hallmark
of MS is the formation of demyelinating lesions in the brain and spinal cord, with the immune system
attacking the myelin sheath that normally protects nerve fibers in the brain. There are now 2.8
million people worldwide who have MS, and every five minutes, someone, somewhere in the world is
diagnosed with this disorder.

## Schizophrenia

Schizophrenia affects 1 in 100 people and is a chronic and disabling psychiatric illness. It is
amongst the top ten causes of disease burden in working adults, and patients typically die 20 years
prematurely. Antipsychotic drugs have been the cornerstone and first-line treatment for
schizophrenia over the last 60 years. However, they are ineffective or not tolerated in
three-quarters of patients and, even where they are effective they have limited efficacy for the
negative and cognitive symptoms, and are not disease modifying.

# Minnesotans are developing ways to replace, restore, or regenerate cells, tissues, and organs to
# help people all over the world return to better health.

Minnesotans are developing ways to replace, restore, or regenerate cells, tissues, and organs to
help people all over the world return to better health.
[Apply for a Grant][15] [View Grants][16] [View Overview Video][17]

In 2014, the Minnesota State Legislature allocated funding for research, commercialization, and
clinical translation initiatives that improve or increase access to scientifically proven
regenerative medicine throughout the state.

## Our Objectives

[Scientific]

### [Research][18]

Support Minnesota scientific and medical research that has the potential to translate to clinical
advances in regenerative medicine.

[Clinical]

### Clinical Translation

Translate regenerative medicine research into clinical therapies.

[Biobusiness]

### [Biobusiness][19]

Develop Minnesota businesses and infrastructure to deliver regenerative medicine products and
services.

[Educational]

### [Education][20]

For the first five years, 2014-2019, RMM funded programs to educate, recruit and retain a
regenerative medicine workforce in Minnesota.

## Regenerative Medicine Minnesota - Our Story

Follow our path.

We’re adding grains of sand to the dunes of knowledge & discoveries that have preceded us.

### WHERE WE’VE COME FROM

Minnesota has a history of pioneering the future of medicine. We still have that pioneer spirit! In
2014, the Minnesota State Legislature voted to fund a bold program−$4.35 million per year−dedicated
to positioning Minnesota at the forefront of the next era of medicine: regenerative medicine.

### MEDICAL ADVANCES

While antibiotics (like penicillin) and biologics (like statins to lower cholesterol) have saved
millions of lives and prevented great suffering, there are still diseases that cannot be cured.
Regenerative medicine takes aim at the incurable with next-generation solutions to help the body
heal itself. Cell biology and development, medicine, biotechnology, bioengineering, and other
relevant fields are brought together to develop ways to replace, restore, or regenerate the damaged
or malfunctioning cells and tissues that stand between Minnesotans and better health.

### WHAT WE DO

Regenerative Medicine Minnesota (RMM) has a vision for creating a hub of regenerative medicine
knowledge, technology, and practice. We fund a portfolio of research that focuses on areas that
matter to Minnesotans: heart disease, diabetes, brain and spinal injuries, the immune system, liver
disease, cancer, eye disease, and osteoarthritis. We are also working on building the infrastructure
by helping businesses develop the capacity to manufacture the products at a quality and quantity
that they can be provided to patients. In time, we will help bring these new therapies to clinics
across the state.

### GRANT PROCESS

Applications are sent out for review by experts around the world, and grants are awarded based on
their reviews and scoring.

### ADMINISTRATION

RMM has a Board with a wide range of experience, from clinical research trials and the safety of
human subjects, to education, to medical device technology and development, to science and medicine.

heal itself. Cell biology and development, medicine, biotechnology, bioengineering, and other
relevant fields are brought together to develop ways to replace, restore, or regenerate the damaged
or malfunctioning cells and tissues that stand between Minnesotans and better health.

### WHAT WE DO

Regenerative Medicine Minnesota (RMM) has a vision for creating a hub of regenerative medicine
knowledge, technology, and practice. We fund a portfolio of research that focuses on areas that
matter to Minnesotans: heart disease, diabetes, brain and spinal injuries, the immune system, liver
disease, cancer, eye disease, and osteoarthritis. We are also working on building the infrastructure
by helping businesses develop the capacity to manufacture the products at a quality and quantity
that they can be provided to patients. In time, we will help bring these new therapies to clinics
across the state.

### GRANT PROCESS

Applications are sent out for review by experts around the world, and grants are awarded based on
their reviews and scoring.

### ADMINISTRATION

RMM has a Board with a wide range of experience, from clinical research trials and the safety of
human subjects, to education, to medical device technology and development, to science and medicine.
The Board works to ensure that RMM follows strict guidelines: honesty, transparency, fiscal health,
giving grants to the best research, and helping eliminate conflicts of interest.

### THE PATH

One deliberate step at a time, we are laying the groundwork for the future of medicine in Minnesota.
We are finding and funding the best ideas in regenerative medicine. We are creating an environment
to attract and support a strong biotechnology industry. We are building the infrastructure to
deliver new medical therapies. And most importantly, we are planning to bring those discoveries and
new treatments to Minnesotans throughout the state.

Follow our progress and help us lead the way in the future of medicine in Minnesota…and in the
world.

The full potential of targeted oncology is waiting to be unlocked. That’s why we relentlessly pursue
every possibility to create new cancer breakthroughs and power our approach with people who think
hard, care hard and act with urgency.

At SpringWorks, we bring tenacity to work every day because patients need answers now.

## Let’s get novel for rare oncology

Our late-stage rare oncology programs have the potential to be best-in-class treatments for patients
with devastating diseases.

[ Learn More ][49]

## Let’s dig into BCMA combinations
## in multiple myeloma

Our gamma secretase inhibitor, nirogacestat, is being evaluated as part of several B-cell maturation
agent (BCMA) combination therapy regimens in collaboration with industry and academia.

[ Learn More ][50]

## People with devastating
## diseases need more champions.

## Let’s make a difference.

We understand the physical and emotional toll of living with a severe rare disease or a devastating
cancer, which is why we are committed to developing new treatments for people dealing with them.
Helping people live longer, healthier lives is core to our mission and central to our work.

[ Learn more about our work ][51]

## Our values drive us

[Care Hard][52] • [Ambition Without Ego][53] • [Think Deeply, Act Quickly][54] • [Good Enough is
Never Enough][55] • [In It Together][56]

#### Care Hard

We take caring very seriously. We care about our patients deeply, intensely, and relentlessly. Every
day, we care for patients by working harder to develop solutions others haven’t.

#### Ambition Without Ego

We exist to ignite the power of promising science to unleash new possibilities for patients. To make
this audacious ambition a reality, we must not let personal pride, empty rhetoric, or ego get in the
way.

#### Think Deeply, Act Quickly

Our team is measured, comprehensive, and thoughtful about every move we make, but we’re also driven
by a sense of urgency because we know that patients are waiting. We delicately and expertly balance
thinking and acting while always upholding our commitment to the highest standards of ethics and
integrity.

#### Good Enough is Never Enough

“Good enough” is never enough for the patients and families counting on us. That’s why we constantly
push ourselves to become smarter, better, and faster in pursuit of our ambition.

#### In It Together

We’re a team, first and foremost. Each and every SpringWorker is all in with their coworkers,
partners, and patients. We do our best work when we all get together, hurling jokes and big ideas,
and collectively making it happen.

> completely changed my life and led to my leg being amputated.
> Dana, Desmoid Tumor Patient

# Synapse — A Collaborative Platform for Open Biomedical Science

**Synapse** is a collaborative data-sharing and analysis platform built and operated by **Sage
Bionetworks**, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit biomedical research organization based in Seattle, Washington.

## About Sage Bionetworks

Sage Bionetworks is a nonprofit research organization whose mission is *to drive a new age of
discovery through truly open science and radical collaboration.*

Our vision is *to create a world where silos within and across science and technology no longer
exist, forging a path to optimal human health.*

We are a trusted leader in data sharing and reuse, enabling a rapid acceleration in biomedical
discoveries and the transformation of medicine. *Better Science Together* is the principle that
guides our work with researchers, clinicians, patient communities, and funders worldwide.

## What Synapse Does

Synapse is the platform Sage Bionetworks uses to make biomedical research data findable, accessible,
interoperable, and reusable (FAIR). Researchers, clinicians, and data scientists use Synapse to:
* Share large biomedical datasets across institutions, with appropriate access controls, data-use
  agreements, and governance.
* Run reproducible analyses on shared data with documented provenance.
* Coordinate consortium science across disease areas including Alzheimer's disease,
  neurofibromatosis, ALS, rare cancers, and others.
* Power public-facing knowledge portals such as the AD Knowledge Portal, the NF Data Portal, and the
  ALS Knowledge Portal.

# We make healthcare
# talk human

At Zana, we use the power of voice and AI to support better health outcomes - from digital health
companions to advanced voice-based diagnostics.

[Our journey of using AI for good][1]

At Zana, we use the power of voice and AI to support better health outcomes - from digital health
companions to advanced voice-based diagnostics.

[Our journey of using AI for good][2]

## The Power of Voice

Similar to traditional biological markers, such as heart rate and blood, voice can be used to
evaluate a person's health. Artificial Intelligence technology allows to extract digital voice
biomarkers, which are quantifiable characteristics providing valuable health-related information.

[The Power of Voice]

## Impact of Voice Biomarkers

Voice alterations serve as early predictors of disease progression, as they may occur even before
experiencing other subjective symptoms.

Continuous voice analysis enables:

[Proactive Care & Timely Adjustment of Treatment]
Proactive Care & Timely Adjustment of Treatment
[Efficient Remote Monitoring in Clinical Research]
Efficient Remote Monitoring in Clinical Research
[Prevention of Hospitalization]
Prevention of Hospitalization
[Explore Voice Biomarkers][3]
OUR PLATFORM

## Zana AI Platform for Voice Analysis
* Voice recordings collected via mobile app or call center are sent to Zana SAAS platform.
* Our AI technology recognizes voice patterns associated with certain health outcomes and predicts
  health scores.
* Analyzed results are received in the desired system or API.

[Explore the platform ][4]
[Zana AI Platform flow]
[Zana voice app preview]

## Seamless& simple.

AI-powered voice technology drives innovation in healthcare, from diagnosis and risk prediction to
clinical research and remote monitoring.

## Revolutionizing
## Cardiorespiratory Care

Currently, we focus on two applications in respiratory diseases and cardiology - the leading causes
of hospitalization worldwide.

[Explore the platform][5]
[Vocal Biomarkers in Heart Failure]

### Vocal Biomarkers in Heart Failure

Zana's platform supports novel biomarkers from clinical data to detect heart failure exacerbations
early and predict decompensation.

[Vocal Biomarkers in Respiratory Diseases]

### Vocal Biomarkers in Respiratory Diseases

Zana's customized app uses vocal biomarkers to predict shortness of breath and declining lung
function in asthma and COPD patients.

## Who we work with

[Telemonitoring Providers]

### Telemonitoring Providers
* Increase the speed and reduce the cost of diagnosis with vocal biomarkers.
* Advance monitoring and support more indications.

[Read more][6]
[Pharmaceutical Companies]

### Pharmaceutical Companies
* Evaluate efficacy and safety of new medication, faster.
* Digitize clinical trials and collect real-world patient data with Zana's patient companion.

[Read more][7]
[MedTech Companies]

### MedTech Companies
* Extend your devices and patient apps with Zana's voice analysis for accurate predictions and
  personalized support.

[Read more][8]

Scientific Depth

## We bring deep healthcare and research expertise to voice AI

Zana works at the intersection of clinical research, digital health, and applied AI. Our approach is
shaped through close collaboration with hospitals, research groups, and healthcare innovation
partners.

These collaborations help us validate voice biomarkers in real-world care pathways and design
technology that is useful in practice, not just in theory.

Selected collaborators

Maastricht UMC+University Hospital of WürzburgFraunhofer IPAAlcedis
[Maastricht UMC+]

### Long-term clinical collaboration in respiratory care

Together with Maastricht UMC+, Zana advances voice-based telemonitoring for COPD and asthma,
combining clinical expertise with real-world patient data collection.

Trusted by renowned clinical and industry partners

### Рад приветствовать Вас на этом сайте!

Меня зовут Бетехтин Михаил Сергеевич, я кандидат медицинских наук, дерматовенеролог, онколог и
врач-косметолог. С 14 лет моя жизнь неразрывно связана с медициной. Все годы обучения в училище,
затем в университете и после получения диплома лишь утвердили меня в правильности выбранного
направления. На сайте Вы можете найти информационные материалы, касающиеся различных вопросов
дерматологии, венерологии, косметологии и дерматоонкологии.

# EUROPEAN BRAIN COUNCIL

### The European Brain Council (EBC) is a network of key players in the “Brain Area”,
### with a membership encompassing scientific societies,
### patient organisations, professional societies and industry partners.

### WHO WE ARE

A non-profit organisation based in Brussels, its main mission is to promote brain research with the
ultimate goal of improving the lives of the millions of Europeans living with brain conditions.

[MISSION][129]

### WHAT WE DO

With the aim to speak with one voice, EBC stands as the platform to foster cooperation between its
member organisations and other stakeholders, consistently promoting dialogue between scientists,
industry and society.

[MEMBERS][130]

### PROJECTS & INITIATIVES

EBC has been involved in many projects ever since its creation and continues to be, both EU-funded
and EBC/Partner funded. Its participation in these projects results from concerted discussions with
its members organisations.

# NF affects 1 in every 2,000 births

**What is NF?** NF refers to a group of genetic conditions that cause tumors to grow on nerves
throughout the body. NF includes neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) and all types of schwannomatosis
(SWN), including *NF2*-related schwannomatosis (*NF2*-SWN), formerly known as neurofibromatosis type
2, or *NF2*. NF affects 4 million people worldwide. Anyone can be born with NF, and it impacts
everyone differently.

# NF affects 1 in every 2,000 births

**What is NF?** NF refers to a group of genetic conditions that cause tumors to grow on nerves
throughout the body. NF includes neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) and all types of schwannomatosis
(SWN), including *NF2*-related schwannomatosis (*NF2*-SWN), formerly known as neurofibromatosis type
2, or *NF2*. NF affects 4 million people worldwide. Anyone can be born with NF, and it impacts
everyone differently.

# Bold ideas. Big Impact.

Van Andel Institute began with a vision: improve human health through biomedical research and
science education. We do more than dream about it, we strive to make it a reality every day.

[Learn More][45]

## ABOUT VAI

Van Andel Institute engages the world’s brightest minds and advances the boldest ideas in pursuit of
the biggest breakthroughs for humanity.

[ Learn more ][46]

## Latest from Vai

[ Learn More ][47]

## RESEARCH, EDUCATE, INSPIRE

Every day, we collaborate at the forefront of fundamental and translational science in pursuit of
breakthrough treatment strategies for cancer, Parkinson’s and other diseases.

We believe that hope for tomorrow lives in the students of today. Our Graduate School offers a
rigorous research-intensive Ph.D. program that develops leaders in molecular and cellular biology.
Our inquiry-based approaches for K–12 education help create classrooms where curiosity, creativity
and critical thinking thrive.

### Research

How do you arrive at revolutionary treatments and breakthroughs? By unleashing a global coalition of
brilliant scientific minds, fostering an entrepreneurial, collaborative process — and doing a world
of good.

[ Learn More ][52]

### Graduate School

Van Andel Institute Graduate School develops scientists to be tomorrow’s biomedical research leaders
through an intense, problem-focused Ph.D. degree in molecular and cell biology.

[ Learn More ][53]

### K-12 Education

We create classrooms where curiosity, creativity and critical thinking thrive.

[ Learn More ][54]

### Our People


How do we move closer each day to improving health and enhancing lives? By bringing together
hard-working scientists, educators, staff and students and providing the resources and support
necessary for them to succeed.

[ Learn More ][55]

### Donor Stories


Each of our dedicated supporters has a story for why they give: a mother diagnosed with breast
cancer, a brother living with Parkinson’s, a lifelong passion for educating children, or something
else entirely. We are honored to share them all.

name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### What is GOMEKLI?

GOMEKLI (mirdametinib) is a prescription medicine used to treat adults and children 2 years of age
and older with neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) who have plexiform neurofibromas (PN) that cause
symptoms and cannot be completely removed by surgery.

It is not known if GOMEKLI is safe and effective in children under 2 years of age.

### Important Safety Information

#### Before taking GOMEKLI, tell your healthcare provider about all of your medical conditions,
#### including if you:
* Have eye problems
* Have heart problems
* Are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. GOMEKLI can harm your unborn baby
  
  #### Females who are able to become pregnant:
  * Your healthcare provider should check to see if you are pregnant before you begin treatment with
    GOMEKLI.
  * Use effective birth control (contraception) during treatment with GOMEKLI and for 6 weeks after
    your last dose.
  * Tell your healthcare provider right away if you become pregnant or think you may be pregnant
    during treatment with GOMEKLI.
  
  #### Males with female partners who are able to become pregnant:
  * Use effective birth control (contraception) during treatment with GOMEKLI and for 3 months after
    your last dose.
  * Tell your healthcare provider right away if your female partner becomes pregnant or thinks she
    may be pregnant during treatment with GOMEKLI.
* Are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed. It is not known if GOMEKLI passes into your breastmilk.
  * Do not breastfeed during treatment with GOMEKLI and for 1 week after your last dose.
  * Talk to your healthcare provider about the best way to feed your baby during this time.

**Tell your healthcare provider about all the medicines you take,** including prescription and
over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements.

### How should I take GOMEKLI?
* Take GOMEKLI exactly as your healthcare provider tells you to take it. Your healthcare provider
  may change your dose, temporarily stop, or permanently stop treatment with GOMEKLI if you develop
  certain side effects.
* Take GOMEKLI twice a day, about 12 hours apart, for 21 days, followed by 7 days off treatment, to
  complete a 28-day treatment cycle. Your healthcare provider will decide how many treatment cycles
  are right for you.
* Take GOMEKLI with or without food.

### What is GOMEKLI?

GOMEKLI (mirdametinib) is a prescription medicine used to treat adults and children 2 years of age
and older with neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) who have plexiform neurofibromas (PN) that cause
symptoms and cannot be completely removed by surgery.

It is not known if GOMEKLI is safe and effective in children under 2 years of age.

### Important Safety Information

#### Before taking GOMEKLI, tell your healthcare provider about all of your medical conditions,
#### including if you:
* Have eye problems
* Have heart problems
* Are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. GOMEKLI can harm your unborn baby
  
  #### Females who are able to become pregnant:
  * Your healthcare provider should check to see if you are pregnant before you begin treatment with
    GOMEKLI.
  * Use effective birth control (contraception) during treatment with GOMEKLI and for 6 weeks after
    your last dose.
  * Tell your healthcare provider right away if you become pregnant or think you may be pregnant
    during treatment with GOMEKLI.
  
  #### Males with female partners who are able to become pregnant:
  * Use effective birth control (contraception) during treatment with GOMEKLI and for 3 months after
    your last dose.
  * Tell your healthcare provider right away if your female partner becomes pregnant or thinks she
    may be pregnant during treatment with GOMEKLI.
* Are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed. It is not known if GOMEKLI passes into your breastmilk.
  * Do not breastfeed during treatment with GOMEKLI and for 1 week after your last dose.
  * Talk to your healthcare provider about the best way to feed your baby during this time.

**Tell your healthcare provider about all the medicines you take,** including prescription and
over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements.

### How should I take GOMEKLI?
* Take GOMEKLI exactly as your healthcare provider tells you to take it. Your healthcare provider
  may change your dose, temporarily stop, or permanently stop treatment with GOMEKLI if you develop
  certain side effects.
* Take GOMEKLI twice a day, about 12 hours apart, for 21 days, followed by 7 days off treatment, to
  complete a 28-day treatment cycle. Your healthcare provider will decide how many treatment cycles
  are right for you.
* Take GOMEKLI with or without food.
* GOMEKLI comes in two different dosage forms, GOMEKLI capsules and GOMEKLI tablets for oral
  suspension. Your healthcare provider will decide the dosage form and dose of GOMEKLI that is right
  for you.
* **If you take GOMEKLI capsules**: Swallow each capsule whole with drinking water. If more than 1
  capsule is required, swallow 1 capsule at a time. Do not open, break or chew the capsules.
* **If you take GOMEKLI tablets for oral suspension, either**:
  * Swallow each tablet for oral suspension whole with drinking water. If more than 1 tablet is
    required, swallow 1 tablet at a time.
  * #### OR
  * Disperse the tablets for oral suspension in drinking water to make a liquid (suspension) before
    you take or give GOMEKLI.
  
  See the “Instructions for Use” that come with your medicine for instructions on how to prepare and
  take GOMEKLI tablets for oral suspension.
* If you miss a dose of GOMEKLI, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at your regularly
  scheduled time.
* If you vomit at any time after taking GOMEKLI, do not take an additional dose. Take your next dose
  at your regularly scheduled time.

### What are the possible side effects of GOMEKLI?

**GOMEKLI may cause serious side effects, including:**
* **Eye problems.** GOMEKLI may cause eye problems that can lead to blindness. Your healthcare
  provider will check your vision before and during treatment with GOMEKLI. Tell your healthcare
  provider right away if you get any of the following signs or symptoms of eye problems:
  * Blurred vision
  * Loss of vision
  * Other changes to your vision
* **Heart problems.** GOMEKLI may lower the amount of blood pumped by your heart, which is common in
  children during treatment with GOMEKLI and can also be severe. Your healthcare provider will do
  tests before you start GOMEKLI treatment, every 3 months during your first year of treatment, and
  then as needed to make sure your heart is working properly. Tell your healthcare provider right

  * Shortness of breath

# [Our Services]Healthcare Integration Services for Labs and Hospitals

[ Let's talk about your project ][61]

We help healthcare organizations connect EHR, LIS, PACS, and billing workflows using HL7, FHIR, and
secure APIs. Whether you need new interfaces, modernization, or ongoing support, our team focuses on
reliable data exchange you can maintain.

### What we integrate

Healthcare integrations usually break when standards, vendors, and workflows don’t line up. We help
teams connect the systems and formats they rely on most:
* **[HL7 v2 messaging][62]**: ADT, ORM, ORU, and custom interface workflows
* **[FHIR APIs and SMART on FHIR][63]** use cases
* **[EHR integrations][64]** for clinical and operational data exchange
* **[LIS integrations][65]** for lab orders, results, and outreach connectivity
* **[PACS and imaging workflows (DICOM)][66]** that need reliable routing and access
* **[RCM integrations][67]** for eligibility, claims, remittance, and reporting
* **[Healthcare API development][68]** for secure system-to-system connectivity

Not sure where to start? **[A short discovery call][69]** usually clarifies the best path.

## KOSELUGO^{®} (selumetinib) is approved for adults living with NF1 plexiform neurofibromas

Koselugo is an FDA-approved therapy for adults and children 1 year of age and older with
neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) who have plexiform neurofibromas (PN) that cause symptoms and cannot
be completely removed by surgery.

Koselugo in Adults Koselugo in Children
[Sarah, age 42, living with NF1 PN. Sarah is not currently taking Koselugo.]

Sarah, age 42, living with NF1 PN.

## You’ve been fighting a fearsome opponent. Now shrink it down to size.

In a clinical study, 66% (33/50) of children and teens with NF1 saw their plexiform neurofibroma
shrink by at least 20% with Koselugo. In a separate clinical study, after 16 months of treatment,
20% of adults treated with Koselugo (14/71) saw their plexiform neurofibroma shrink by at least 20%
from the start of the study compared with 5% (4/74) of adults on placebo.^{*}

See more study details in the links below.

Koselugo in Adults Koselugo in Children

*A placebo is a treatment that doesn't contain medicine.

[Kylie, age 19, living with NF1 PN. Kylie is currently taking Koselugo.]

Kylie, age 19, living with NF1 PN.

## Koselugo is backed by almost 8 years of established safety in children and teens

In the SPRINT Phase 1 and Phase 2 Stratum 1 studies, 74 children and teens received Koselugo twice
daily. Half received Koselugo for more than 4.4 years. Treatment duration ranged from 28 days to 7.7
years.

See more study details in the link below.

**What are the possible side effects of Koselugo?****
**Koselugo may cause serious side effects, including:****
* Heart problems. Koselugo can lower the amount of blood pumped by your heart, which can be severe.
  Your healthcare provider will do tests before and during treatment to check how well your heart is
  working. Tell your healthcare provider right away if you get any of the following signs or
  symptoms: persistent coughing or wheezing, shortness of breath, swelling of your ankles and feet,
  tiredness, increased heart rate.
* Eye problems. Koselugo can cause eye problems that can lead to blindness. Your healthcare provider
  will check your vision before and during treatment. Tell your healthcare provider right away if
  you get new or worsening vision changes, including: blurred vision, loss of vision, dark spots in
  your vision (floaters), other changes to your vision.
* Stomach, intestine, and mouth (gastrointestinal) problems. Koselugo can cause diarrhea, vomiting,
  nausea, and mouth sores. Diarrhea can be severe with Koselugo. Tell your healthcare provider right
  away the first time that you get diarrhea during treatment. Your healthcare provider may give you
  medicine to help control your diarrhea and may tell you to drink more fluids.

  of the following signs of skin problems: rash that covers a large area of your body, flat skin
  rash, raised bumps on your skin, skin bumps that look like acne, blisters, peeling skin, itchy
  rash, hair thinning or hair loss (alopecia).

# Welcome to OnPatient

The easy way to manage your personal health records

[Sign Up][4] [COVID-19 Updates][5]

## Take control of your medical records.

Securely connect with all your medical providers with OnPatient, trusted by over 13 million users.
Gain access to your information via web or the OnPatient App.

[[Onpatient patient portal on ipad, iphone, or web]][6]

## How to Connect

[envelope show to send email invite to patients to access Onpatient icon]

#### STEP 1

Ask your provider to send you an email invite to the OnPatient Portal.

[Check list on how to sign up icon]

#### STEP 2

Open the OnPatient invite email, press the “sign up” button and register online.

[ipad and iphone downloading app icon]

#### STEP 3

[Download][7] the OnPatient app from the Apple App Store.

[continual user icon]

#### STEP 4

Launch the OnPatient app and log in to connect to your medical provider.

## Through the OnPatient portal, you can
* Fill out any paperwork before your appointment to make checking in easier
* View your upcoming appointments and check-in online
* Schedule and cancel appointments from your computer or mobile device
* Message your doctor through a HIPAA compliant portal
* Manage your contact and insurance information
* Access your medical record
* Have educational material sent directly to your account
* Connect your child's account and manage their health record with yours
* View statements and pay online

* Each practice personalizes OnPatient, some of these features may not be available.

# Healthcare Integration Free and Open Source No Vendor Lock-In

A community-driven open source engine, fully compatible with Mirth^{®} Connect and extended by a
growing ecosystem of free plugins.

[Download][17]

## Latest news

[See all news →][18]

  ### Role Based Access Control Plugin Released
  
  An open-source RBAC plugin for Open Integration Engine 4.6.0. Define your own roles with
  per-permission grants and channel-level restrictions, replacing the engine's default always-allow
  authorization controller.
  
  ][19]
* [ July 9, 2026
  
  ### OIE 4.6.0 Released
  
  Open Integration Engine 4.6.0 is now generally available and recommended for production use. It
  moves to a Java 17 minimum, adds editor and CLI conveniences, and remediates 24 CVEs through
  dependency upgrades.
  
  ][20]
* [ June 5, 2026
  
  ### OIE Applies to Join the Eclipse Foundation
  
  OIE has submitted its application to join the Eclipse Foundation, beginning the move to neutral,
  community-owned governance.
  
  ][21]

## Built by the community.

A growing ecosystem of open source plugins extends OIE into the work you actually need to do. Here
are a few.

[See all plugins →][22]
* [ [TLS Manager screenshot] ][23]
  
  ### TLS Manager
  
  Browser-based and in-Administrator certificate management for OIE. Inspect the Java trust store,
  add trusted certificates, and manage local key pairs, with search, validity dates, and
  fingerprints.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][24]
* [ [Cache Manager screenshot] ][25]
  
  ### Cache Manager
  
  In-memory key-value lookups against external databases, with lazy loading, HikariCP pooling, and a
  dedicated admin UI and inspector.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][26]
* [ [Channel & Code Template History screenshot] ][27]
  
  ### Channel & Code Template History
  
  Built-in version history for channels and code templates. Side-by-side diff viewer with word-level
  highlighting, right-click revert, and database-backed storage.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][28]
* [ [Source Code Search screenshot] ][29]
  
  ### Source Code Search
  
  Grep across channel scripts, code templates, global scripts, and message templates, with regex,
  scoping, highlighted matches, and JSON/CSV export.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][30]

## What is Panda Trial?

Panda Trial (also written PandaTrial) is an AI-powered clinical trial matching platform that helps
patients find clinical trials they are actually eligible for. Unlike generic keyword searches on
ClinicalTrials.gov, Panda Trial analyzes your complete health profile — condition, age, medications,
location — against each trial's specific eligibility criteria to deliver ranked, transparent
matches.

Panda Trial — also written PandaTrial, and often searched as Panda Trial AI — is free for patients.
We sync new and updated studies from ClinicalTrials.gov every day, validate every condition against
real clinical vocabularies like MeSH and SNOMED CT, and check your profile against each study's
eligibility criteria — so a match on Panda Trial is a study you can genuinely pursue.

Every match includes a visible score breakdown across three pillars — clinical eligibility,
geographic distance, and trial quality — so you can verify why each trial made your list. No hidden
algorithms, no promoted placements, no black boxes.

## How AI Clinical Trial Matching Works

Panda Trial's 6-layer pipeline combines clinical vocabularies, deterministic rules, and focused AI
to find trials you qualify for.

01

### Enter Your Profile

Share your condition, age, medications, and zip code. No account required for basic clinical trial
matching.

02

### Automated Analysis

Your profile passes through eligibility filters, medical vocabulary validation, and AI-powered
medication conflict detection.

03

### Ranked Matches

Receive a scored list of clinical trials near you, ranked by eligibility fit, distance to study
sites, and trial quality.

[See the full 6-layer matching pipeline][12]

## Built by a Clinical Research Professional

Panda Trial was created by a certified clinical research coordinator with experience managing
pediatric studies at Children's Hospital Los Angeles and multi-site diabetes device trials at
Medtronic. With a Master's degree in Clinical and Translational Research from George Washington
University, the founder built Panda Trial to solve a problem seen firsthand: qualified patients who
could benefit from a clinical trial had no reliable way to find one.

[Read our approach to clinical trial matching][13]

## Clinical Trial Matching FAQ

Common questions about finding clinical trials with Panda Trial.

### How does Panda Trial find clinical trials for my condition?

Panda Trial uses a multi-layer system that starts by validating your condition against clinical
databases to find truly relevant trials. Then it checks your eligibility, scores each trial on a
weighted formula, and uses AI to detect medication conflicts and parse complex criteria. The result
is a ranked list of clinical trials you are actually eligible for — not just keyword matches.

### Is Panda Trial better than searching ClinicalTrials.gov directly?

ClinicalTrials.gov is the authoritative database, and Panda Trial searches the same trials. The
difference is how results are filtered and presented. ClinicalTrials.gov uses keyword matching,
which returns trials that mention your condition anywhere — including irrelevant contexts. Panda
Trial validates relevance through clinical databases, checks your specific eligibility criteria, and
ranks results by how well they match your complete profile.

### Can I use Panda Trial without creating an account?

Yes. Guest matching lets you enter your condition, age, gender, and zip code to find clinical trials
immediately — no signup required. Creating a free account unlocks additional features like saved
matches, application tracking, medication conflict analysis, and more detailed AI reasoning for your
top matches.

# Pasithea is a biotechnology company focused on the discovery, research and development of
# innovative treatments for central nervous system (CNS) disorders and RASopathies.

Pasithea is developing new therapeutics for the treatment of neurological disorders, including solid
tumors, Neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1), Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), and schizophrenia.

## Our Focus

Our research on therapies is currently focused on developing treatment options for:

## Neurofibromatosis Type 1 (NF1)

NF1 is part of a group of conditions known as neurocutaneous disorders that affect the skin and the
nervous system. NF1 causes tumor growth along nerves in the skin, brain, near the spinal cord and
other parts of the body. These tumors are usually benign (non-cancerous), however they cause a range
of symptoms with varying severity among affected people. People with NF1 typically have problems
with their bones, eyes and nervous system, as well as other complications, including high blood
pressure, learning disabilities, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), seizures and
speech problems. Further, some people with NF1 develop cancerous tumors that grow along nerves and
are at a higher risk of developing other forms of cancer. NF1 accounts for approximately 90% of all
neurofibromatosis cases and occurs in about 1 in 3,000 births. There is no known cure for NF1 and
treatment options vary.

## Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)

ALS is a progressive neurodegenerative disease that affects nerve cells in the brain and spinal
cord, causing loss of muscle control. It most commonly affects people between the ages of 40 and 70,
with an average age of 55 at the time of diagnosis. The average life expectancy after diagnosis is
two to five years, but some patients may live for years or even decades. Currently there is no known
cure or treatment that halts or reverses the progression of ALS, and FDA only approved 2 medications
so far for the treatment of this disorder, both shown to modestly slow the progression of ALS.

## Multiple Sclerosis (MS)

Multiple sclerosis is a chronic and potentially disabling autoimmune disease, and the most common
neurodegenerative disease of the central nervous system in young adults. The pathological hallmark
of MS is the formation of demyelinating lesions in the brain and spinal cord, with the immune system
attacking the myelin sheath that normally protects nerve fibers in the brain. There are now 2.8
million people worldwide who have MS, and every five minutes, someone, somewhere in the world is
diagnosed with this disorder.

## Schizophrenia

Schizophrenia affects 1 in 100 people and is a chronic and disabling psychiatric illness. It is
amongst the top ten causes of disease burden in working adults, and patients typically die 20 years
prematurely. Antipsychotic drugs have been the cornerstone and first-line treatment for
schizophrenia over the last 60 years. However, they are ineffective or not tolerated in
three-quarters of patients and, even where they are effective they have limited efficacy for the
negative and cognitive symptoms, and are not disease modifying.

## Welcome to Unique!

Unique provides support, information and networking to families affected by rare chromosome and gene
disorders.

Our helpline team can help you understand your family member's diagnosis and connect you with
others. Why not join us today? Alternatively, have a look around first and contact us when you're
ready....

with ReNU syndrome in 2024, just after her 3rd birthday. They didn’t think they would ever have

feel like we’re part of a large international family.” After years of uncertainty, they are no

# Minnesotans are developing ways to replace, restore, or regenerate cells, tissues, and organs to
# help people all over the world return to better health.

Minnesotans are developing ways to replace, restore, or regenerate cells, tissues, and organs to
help people all over the world return to better health.
[Apply for a Grant][15] [View Grants][16] [View Overview Video][17]

In 2014, the Minnesota State Legislature allocated funding for research, commercialization, and
clinical translation initiatives that improve or increase access to scientifically proven
regenerative medicine throughout the state.

## Our Objectives

[Scientific]

### [Research][18]

Support Minnesota scientific and medical research that has the potential to translate to clinical
advances in regenerative medicine.

[Clinical]

### Clinical Translation

Translate regenerative medicine research into clinical therapies.

[Biobusiness]

### [Biobusiness][19]

Develop Minnesota businesses and infrastructure to deliver regenerative medicine products and
services.

[Educational]

### [Education][20]

For the first five years, 2014-2019, RMM funded programs to educate, recruit and retain a
regenerative medicine workforce in Minnesota.

[up north map]

[Biobusiness]

Biobusiness creating equipment to support regenerative medicine researchers.

[Educational]

Education programs offered a comprehensive pipeline that encouraged Native Americans to pursue
science, research, and regenerative medicine careers.

[lake country map]

[Biobusiness]

Responding to the growing and increased need for healthcare workers, SCRUBS camps offered
an opportunity to educate students on possible career options.

## Regenerative Medicine Minnesota - Our Story

Follow our path.

We’re adding grains of sand to the dunes of knowledge & discoveries that have preceded us.

### WHERE WE’VE COME FROM

Minnesota has a history of pioneering the future of medicine. We still have that pioneer spirit! In
2014, the Minnesota State Legislature voted to fund a bold program−$4.35 million per year−dedicated
to positioning Minnesota at the forefront of the next era of medicine: regenerative medicine.

### MEDICAL ADVANCES

While antibiotics (like penicillin) and biologics (like statins to lower cholesterol) have saved
millions of lives and prevented great suffering, there are still diseases that cannot be cured.
Regenerative medicine takes aim at the incurable with next-generation solutions to help the body
heal itself. Cell biology and development, medicine, biotechnology, bioengineering, and other
relevant fields are brought together to develop ways to replace, restore, or regenerate the damaged
or malfunctioning cells and tissues that stand between Minnesotans and better health.

### WHAT WE DO

Regenerative Medicine Minnesota (RMM) has a vision for creating a hub of regenerative medicine
knowledge, technology, and practice. We fund a portfolio of research that focuses on areas that
matter to Minnesotans: heart disease, diabetes, brain and spinal injuries, the immune system, liver
disease, cancer, eye disease, and osteoarthritis. We are also working on building the infrastructure
by helping businesses develop the capacity to manufacture the products at a quality and quantity
that they can be provided to patients. In time, we will help bring these new therapies to clinics
across the state.

### GRANT PROCESS

Applications are sent out for review by experts around the world, and grants are awarded based on

## Regenerative Medicine Minnesota - Our Story

Follow our path.

We’re adding grains of sand to the dunes of knowledge & discoveries that have preceded us.

### WHERE WE’VE COME FROM

Minnesota has a history of pioneering the future of medicine. We still have that pioneer spirit! In
2014, the Minnesota State Legislature voted to fund a bold program−$4.35 million per year−dedicated
to positioning Minnesota at the forefront of the next era of medicine: regenerative medicine.

### MEDICAL ADVANCES

While antibiotics (like penicillin) and biologics (like statins to lower cholesterol) have saved
millions of lives and prevented great suffering, there are still diseases that cannot be cured.
Regenerative medicine takes aim at the incurable with next-generation solutions to help the body
heal itself. Cell biology and development, medicine, biotechnology, bioengineering, and other
relevant fields are brought together to develop ways to replace, restore, or regenerate the damaged
or malfunctioning cells and tissues that stand between Minnesotans and better health.

### WHAT WE DO

Regenerative Medicine Minnesota (RMM) has a vision for creating a hub of regenerative medicine
knowledge, technology, and practice. We fund a portfolio of research that focuses on areas that
matter to Minnesotans: heart disease, diabetes, brain and spinal injuries, the immune system, liver
disease, cancer, eye disease, and osteoarthritis. We are also working on building the infrastructure
by helping businesses develop the capacity to manufacture the products at a quality and quantity
that they can be provided to patients. In time, we will help bring these new therapies to clinics
across the state.

### GRANT PROCESS

Applications are sent out for review by experts around the world, and grants are awarded based on
their reviews and scoring.

### ADMINISTRATION

RMM has a Board with a wide range of experience, from clinical research trials and the safety of
human subjects, to education, to medical device technology and development, to science and medicine.
The Board works to ensure that RMM follows strict guidelines: honesty, transparency, fiscal health,
giving grants to the best research, and helping eliminate conflicts of interest.

### THE PATH

One deliberate step at a time, we are laying the groundwork for the future of medicine in Minnesota.
We are finding and funding the best ideas in regenerative medicine. We are creating an environment
to attract and support a strong biotechnology industry. We are building the infrastructure to
deliver new medical therapies. And most importantly, we are planning to bring those discoveries and
new treatments to Minnesotans throughout the state.

Follow our progress and help us lead the way in the future of medicine in Minnesota…and in the
world.

The full potential of targeted oncology is waiting to be unlocked. That’s why we relentlessly pursue
every possibility to create new cancer breakthroughs and power our approach with people who think
hard, care hard and act with urgency.

At SpringWorks, we bring tenacity to work every day because patients need answers now.
